description:

Apparently our most prolific uploader has lost interest (or something else happened, idk) and as a result the rate of new gallery uploads has dropped dramatically. I did not get any feedback about the `html-*.7z` archives that were included in the last torrents, so I decided to get rid of those. This reduces the torrent size by 9G and creating the torrent is now much less of a chore.

Unfortunately I had to scale down my backup systems, so I don't have direct backups of the site anymore. To make up for that, I've included a `_website_backup_<date>.7z` archive that contains the source code and database of the site. It's encrypted, sorry, I'm not comfortable sharing that with the world at this point. But at least I'll be able to fully restore the site from just this torrent if that ever ends up being necessary. Keep this torrent alive, and the site will survive!

My internet connection *still* sucks, so if you can download this torrent on top of the previous version (20201022, or any version after 20190422 really), that would be very much appreciated. You can safely delete `info.txt` (renamed to `!info.txt`) and the `html-*.7z` files if you're not seeding the old torrents.
